# ITK Development helper

A script to make the daily life of a developer a little easier.

## Installation

Download [a release](https://github.com/itk-dev/itkdev-helper/releases) (or [build it yourself](#development)) and put
it somewhere on your path, e.g. `~/bin/`.

Add

``` shell
eval $(itkdev-helper completions)
```

to your `~/.bashrc` or similar.

## Development

`itkdev-helper` is built with [Bashly](https://bashly.dev/).

Run

``` shell
task build:dev
```

to build for development.

Run

``` shell
task build:dev && ./itkdev-helper --help
```

to build and run the generated command.
